## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Minecraft-inspired game in the repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “Blocklands,” a self-contained, isometric 2D voxel sandbox with seeded terrain, exploration, mining, building, and inventory.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game and UI.
- Added keyboard, mouse, and basic touch interactions; added inventory selection and mining/building actions.
- Ran `node --check game.js` successfully.
- Started a local server and opened the game in Playwright. Captured and inspected `screenshots/blocklands.jpg` and `screenshots/blocklands-playing.jpg`; the world and welcome overlay rendered.

### Active
- Validate the latest changes in-browser; mobile controls and favicon were added after the screenshots were captured.
